cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a mixed, rotational tape, 44% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.51% · WTI -2.33% · Brent -2.14% · NatGas -3.06%. At the last close, 44% of 68 energy names were green — a mixed, rotational tape. Grid, Storage & Electrification did the heavy lifting at +1.62%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.62%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -2.12%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +8.27%
